23824816fc28.span: The United States interpreted "appropriate amount" as excluding full UN financing.
It sought an explicit contribution limit to remove ambiguity and enable timely deployment.
The US submitted S/2023/1023 and urged support for the amendment.

5749eebc677b.span: At S/PV.9518, the US proposed an amendment to clarify financing limits, which passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions, including France.
The amended draft subsequently passed unanimously.
The Council agreed to consider AU requests case-by-case, ensuring UN assessed contributions cover up to 75% of budgets, with the remainder mobilized jointly as extrabudgetary resources.
5749eebc677b.uncertain: Ensuring contributions cover up to the limit can imply guaranteed assessed financing. The public decision makes financing case by case.

aeef8af6a787.span: At S/PV.9518, the Council voted on US amendment S/2023/1023 before the final draft.
It was adopted with nine votes in favour, none against, and six abstentions, including France.
The amended draft S/2023/999 subsequently passed unanimously with 15 votes in favour.

b51d87981d21.span: France opposed the US amendment due to insufficient clarity on financing 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
It reaffirmed support for assessed UN financing for AU-led operations and expressed willingness to discuss varying contribution levels between the UN and EU.

b685ad7a0029.span: France could not support the US amendment due to insufficient clarity on financing the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
However, France reaffirmed its support for assessed UN financing for AU-led operations and remained prepared to discuss varying contribution levels between the UN and EU.

cf88197fb18b.span: France abstained on the US amendment clarifying financing limits, citing insufficient clarity on the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
While the amendment passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions including France, the Council unanimously adopted the amended draft.
France reaffirmed support for UN assessed financing covering up to 75 percent of AU-led operation budgets, with the remainder to be jointly mobilized as extrabudgetary resources.
cf88197fb18b.uncertain: The final phrase may conflate France's general support for assessed financing with a position on the numeric limit and joint mobilization.

df73c327d464.span: The US proposed an amendment to clarify financing limits, seeking an explicit contribution cap to remove ambiguity and enable timely deployment.
France abstained, citing insufficient clarity regarding the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
Despite this, the amendment passed with nine votes in favor and six abstentions, including France.
The amended draft subsequently passed unanimously, confirming the Council's agreement to consider AU requests case-by-case with UN assessed contributions covering up to 75 percent of budgets.

f67571cf2bc8.span: The United States clarified that the draft excludes full UN financing, yet requested an explicit contribution limit to eliminate ambiguity and facilitate timely deployment.
It submitted document S/2023/1023 and urged support for this amendment.
